degree_rationale: Two essences (light and darkness) and the Living Spirit's establishment of firmaments — likened to architect building house upon house, separating cut stones and pure stones, preparing the king's chamber. Treats the inner architectural reception of cosmic structures.
direction_rationale: Inward processing of how the firmaments are built and receive their adornment — the king-coming-to-dwell metaphor. Reception within the architecture.
grand_man_function: Spiritual architectural-reception — how cosmic dwellings receive their king.
title: The Two Essences: light and darkness from the beginning
